name: Partial Fill 4
definition: Intention to transfer an ownership of a financial instrument.

ConfirmationQuantity.name: Confirmation Quantity
ConfirmationQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument to be ordered.

DealPrice.name: Deal Price
DealPrice.definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which a trade transaction is to be or has been executed.

PreviouslyExecutedQuantity.name: Previously Executed Quantity
PreviouslyExecutedQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument that has been previously executed.

RemainingQuantity.name: Remaining Quantity
RemainingQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument that is remaining in order.

MatchIncrementQuantity.name: Match Increment Quantity
MatchIncrementQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity that applies to every execution. The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the Match Increment.

PartialFillsRule.definition: A SecuritiesTradeConfirmation should not be used as a TradeExecution report. PartialFills aims at providing a for information summary of the different executions that the confirmation consisted of.
